protocol.generation: All920 requests newly run through each native public service; no historical answer reuse. Same frozen case order, one untimed warmup per system, serial GPU use.
protocol.reference: Full finalized expert KU text; original question, range, reference and metric setting are unchanged.
protocol.judge: Fresh blinded Claude Opus5.5 judgments with source-fidelity and a separate0-4 naturalness scale; exact full-packet duplicates judged once and mapped back.
protocol.metric: Frozen xlm-roberta-large18 raw F1, IDFfalse, slow tokenizer; no tuning. Whole visible answers, errors/refusals zero. Report original105, original-development43, original-validation62, paraphrase306, KU-derived49 and total460.
protocol.interpretation: Shared-source, reused internal evaluation; grouped question variants are correlated. Naturalness and factual meaning assessed separately from BERTScore.
protocol.corpus_policy: Native version corpora: original946 records, E37 adds7 Sumi Jo feedback records. All946 shared records are byte-content equivalent, including all122 expert KUs. The original validator does not support sumijo_feedback. This is a full-system comparison, not a code-only effect estimate.
